mechanistic_findings: Pinned llama.cpp cvec is additive and one-shot full-prompt decode broadcasts the 1D control direction over prompt-token rows.
Pinned llama.cpp batch semantics permit a same-context split-prefill carrier: natural prefix decode, then cvec enablement, then exactly one final prompt-token decode.
Pinned llama.cpp staging API exposes layer-input taps that can extract raw downstream nonterminal activations without modifying the Qwen3 graph.
A split-prefill no-cvec baseline is mandatory because decode partitioning itself may create numeric drift.
Downstream transport must be adjudicated by an independently derived probe/subspace, not by reusing the intervention vector as its own readout.
